ALLTERRA X-SPRINT is the MX helmet range of SMK. Made of 2 outer injected EIRT shells for optimized safety and comfortable fitting, it has been conceived by the world’s most famous MX experts for off road lovers!

title: SMK Terrain Offroad Goggle with Clear Lens (White with Black Strap)
description:
The SMK Offroad Terrain Goggles are engineered for off-road enthusiasts, combining durability, comfort, and performance. Featuring a rigid injection-moulded frame and a curved lens design, they offer a wide, clear field of vision. Ventilation ensures airflow to prevent fogging, while triple-layered foam padding provides a secure, sweat-absorbing fit.

A changeable and adjustable woven strap with triple silicone waves keeps the goggles firmly in place during all rides.

The two-pin tear-off system allows the addition of tear-off films that offers added convenience in muddy or dusty conditions.

Certified to EN1938:2010 standards, SMK Goggles are built to perform. Available in five colors to perfectly match your SMK Allterra Off-Road Helmet.

title: SMK Spare Pinlock 70 Max Vision Lens for Gullwing Helmets
description:
Compatibility Note:

Only suitable for SMK Gullwing Modular Helmets with 100% Max Vision (Pinlock 70) compatible face shields.

  • Consists of 1 unit of Pinlock 70 Lens only for SMK Gullwing Helmet
  • Pinlock 70 Visor NOT included
  • This antifog lens will fit only on SMK Gullwing Pinlock 70 Ready visor

Overview:

  • The 100% Max Vision Pinlock 70 fog resistant insert lens is a premium solution for SMK helmets.
  • This lens has become the benchmark for fog resistant performance that is most commonly used by riders across the world.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.

Specification:

  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.
Specification:
  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

title: SMK Spare Pinlock 70 Max Vision Lens for Typhoon
description:
Compatibility Note:

Only suitable for SMK TYPHOON Helmets with 100% Max Vision (Pinlock 70 VISOR) compatible face shields.

Additional Notes: 

  • Pinlock 70 Lens only x 1 unit included
  • Pinlock 70 Visor NOT included

Overview:

  • The 100% Max Vision Pinlock 70 fog resistant insert lens is a premium solution for SMK helmets.
  • This lens has become the benchmark for fog resistant performance that is most commonly used by riders across the world.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.

Specification:

  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

Note:

  • SMK Spares & Visor products do NOT qualify for returns, exchange and refund policy.
  • Images shown for illustration purpose only.
  • Actual product may vary in finish, specifications, look without any discretion from manufacturer.

title: SMK Spare Pinlock 70 Max Vision Lens for Stellar and Titan Helmets
description:
Compatibility Note:

Only suitable for SMK TITAN Helmets and SMK STELLAR Helmets with 100% Max Vision (Pinlock 70 VISOR) compatible face shields.

Additional Notes: 

  • Pinlock 70 Lens only x 1 unit included
  • Pinlock 70 Visor NOT included

Overview:

  • The 100% Max Vision Pinlock 70 fog resistant insert lens is a premium solution for SMK helmets.
  • This lens has become the benchmark for fog resistant performance that is most commonly used by riders across the world.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and, therefore the surface basically dry when used.
  • The insert has a silicone seal that creates a double shield system.

Specification:

  • Double shield system created by a silicon seal
  • Dry hydrofilic technology
  • Easy to clean and install
  • Interchangeable with other Pinlock lenses
  • 100% Max Vision® technology provides a clear view throughout the complete eye port of the shield

Overview:

  • The Pinlock 70 is a premium fog resistant solution for riders.
  • Enhanced with stronger fog resistant properties, the insert lens has extended fog resistant endurance which helps riders see better through challenging weather conditions.
  • The Pinlock 70 creates a double shield system through a silicon seal between the helmet face shield and Pinlock insert lens, which makes up a double glass type of solution that prevents fogging.
  • The insert is made of a moisture absorbing plastic and therefore, the surface basically dry when used.
    This air-tight pocket ensures that the difference in temperature becomes significantly lowered.
  • The Pinlock insert absorbs moisture on the inside and offers you continuous clear visibility.

100% Max Vision:

The Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses maximizes fog resistant coverage within the helmet face shield via a custom designed cavity area that enables the lens to fit perfectly. Pinlock 100% Max Vision insert lenses are also offered in colored versions.

title: SMK Gullwing Tekker Black Grey Yellow Gloss (GL264) Helmet
description:
Flip-up helmet for tourers and everyday commuters, this helmet provides comfortable fit and a dynamic outer shell design.

The double P/J homologation allows it to be used both as an open face and a full-face
helmet, ensuring maximum safety in both conditions.

A smartly designed vent system on the top and mouth areas along with the clear vision of flat high-grade Pinlock® ready visor offer full comfort even on extreme weather circumstances both on long trips and everyday commuting.

SMK Gullwing offers a complete range of features such as Internal Retractable Sun Visor, Wind Stops, and Original Pinlock® ready visor to prevent fogging. 

Technical Specification:

  • External shell:  EIRT (Energy Impact Resistant Thermoplastic)

  • Homologation: ECE 22-05 (P/J)
    Dual certification providing maximum protection to rider when riding Open face or Full face
  • Internal shell: moulded in differentiated density EPS
  • Chin piece: opened using a single button inside the chin piece itself
  • Multiple Density EPS
  • Quick Release Visor Mechanism

  • Proudly Made in India

Inner:

  • Breathable, hypoallergenic liners
  • Fully removable and washable.
  • Resil coated comfort liner.
  • Antistatic Moisture Controlled Fabric
  • Lower wind stop and removable nose guard.

Retention system: 
Equipped with a practical quick release buckle for micro metric adjustment.

Air Ventilation:

  • Chin Air Vents
  • Channeled Exhausts
  • Hot Air Rear Exhausts
  • Top Air Vents

Visor:

  • Scratch-resistant
  • Wide Vision
  • UV Resistant
  • Pinlock Ready

Weighs: 1700 (+/-50) grams. Sturdy yet light and functional

SMK Gullwing Modular / Flip Up Helmets will come with Pinlock® Original P30 Anti Fog Clear Lens Included.
